name: Aggregate Uniqueness Constraint
description: Replaced the pairwise inequality constraints and explicit uniqueness restatements with a global cardinality sum constraint. Instead of saying "no two elements share a coordinate", the problem requires that the sum of the number of distinct values in each dimension equals 3k. Since exactly k items are chosen, this forces each dimension to have exactly k distinct values, logically equivalent to the original constraint but structurally different, preventing superficial mapping to Exact Cover / DLX.
